payload.name: Resolve relative-time references to prior plans during extraction
payload.description: When a message uses a relative time (tomorrow, next week) to confirm or schedule a plan/event mentioned earlier in the session, resolve the date from the message timestamp and extract or update the plan memory.
content: During extraction, when a message contains a relative time reference (e.g., 'tomorrow', 'next week') that confirms or sets the date of a plan/event already discussed earlier in the session, resolve the reference against the message timestamp to an absolute date and generate an extraction candidate for that plan/event.
Use the earlier plan description from the session as the memory content/evidence, and attach the current message as an additional source; do not create a new memory for the relative phrase alone.
Skip extraction if the referenced plan is already stored with the same resolved date, or if the relative time does not refer to any previously discussed plan/event.

solves: This solves missed extraction of plan dates when users confirm plans with relative time without restating the plan. Future pattern: a session contains an earlier plan mention and later a message like 'see you tomorrow'; the agent must produce a dated plan/event candidate. It must not apply to casual relative time not tied to a prior plan or to plans already stored with the same date.
